name: Zerah
bio: Zerah the Cushite led a massive invading army of a million men and 300 chariots against King Asa of Judah at Mareshah. Asa cried out to the LORD for help, and the LORD struck down the Cushites before him; Asa and his army pursued them all the way to Gerar, destroying the towns around it and carrying off great plunder, flocks, and camels (2 Chronicles 14:9-15). He is a different figure from Zerah, Judah's son by Tamar.
